patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Keep frame bitmaps and component previews as lossless WebP, about 40% smaller than the PNGs they replace, with the same pixels

minor.comment: A state can take away a prop or style the design sets, and Paste style in a state leaves only the copied style

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Saving after undoing a token value a theme didn't have takes it back out of the stylesheet, with any rule it leaves empty

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Box a component that draws only text by its text, so it can be hovered, picked and sized on the canvas

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Load aliased library providers, icons and sample values consistently and reject obsolete manifests

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Align, Wrap, resizing, nudging, dragging and the clipboard read layers as the frame shows them, with variants, viewport patches and bound values; a copied binding is kept only where the design pasted into has that param

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Zoomed-out frames and agents' renders no longer draw a component from a file that's gone

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Agents' frames, exports and accessibility checks draw library designs' instances and unsaved token values as the canvas does, and no offscreen frame inherits another's token values

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: MCP's tools/list no longer publishes output schemas, cutting it from 33 KB to under 12 KB; structuredContent and CLI --json are unchanged

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Keep text given to a new library part rather than labelling over it

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: A call without --tab finds the project its folder is in through links, such as macOS's /var

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: The canvas menu says Show for a layer the variant shown hides, and Make component checks the result against the variant and param defaults the board shows

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Fingerprint every lockfile package-manager detection recognizes, such as npm-shrinkwrap.json, and the tsconfigs a project's configs extend, so cached props refresh when they change

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Estimate the size of a board the canvas hasn't drawn from its frames, laid out as the canvas lays them out, so Overlaps() catches wide and tall boards

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Inserting a component that passes its props to an input no longer gives it children, and library samples' text ends at a sentence or a whole word

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Props refresh after you change tsconfig paths or dependencies

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Default execute labels to "Edit designs", report failed MCP executions as tool errors, and reject ambiguous requests, blank labels and malformed patches before they reach the app

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Draw zoomed-out bitmaps, agent screenshots and measurements, exports and accessibility checks in the same window height as the live frame, keeping a mode's screen height when the frame grows with its content

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Capture frames' bitmaps in four offscreen windows at once, so a project opened for the first time has them in less than half the time

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Generate an app's library from the same sources and global stylesheets project detection finds, following tsconfig references, the HTML entry's stylesheet imports and relative @imports

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Read token themes and categories the same way in parity lib and the app: [data-theme] attributes are themes, names like fontSizeBase300 are font sizes, and a library's .dark beats its prefers-color-scheme block

patch.author: noreply@anthropic.com
patch.comment: Keep values under media queries, such as a prefers-color-scheme: dark block, out of the default theme's tokens

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Use declared caller names instead of guessing agent identity

minor.author: noreply@anthropic.com
minor.comment: Agent calls merge per design with edits made while they run, and are refused naming the designs when both changed the same one

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Make a picture of every component offscreen, after the canvas's bitmaps, and keep it on disk so a reopened project draws none again

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: parity modes and the MCP get_modes tool list the project's viewports (the ids Responsive takes) with their window heights, its modes (the ids renders take) resolved, and what each design shows; naming a design adds its frames' sizes. Mistyped ids now suggest the nearest ones first.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Frame bitmaps are kept on disk in app data, so a project opened again shows them without capturing each frame again; View > Clear bitmap cache removes them.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Components show their preview in a card beside the row, and right-clicking one offers View in Storybook and View code, which opens it in your editor (chosen in Settings). Tooltips are raised in the theme's own colors. Taking a component off the list by hand is gone.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Agents get every result as data, in --json and MCP structuredContent with published output schemas, and failures as stable error codes with the input at fault, whether to retry, and the valid ids to use instead. Token and console reads are bounded by --limit.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Add MCP token, component and prop reads, validate options consistently, and report screenshot and audit failures in both interfaces

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: parity status and the MCP get_status tool say where a tab's edits stand: its revision, what's applied but not saved (files and token values), the last save and failed writes, and undo and redo, with an optional bounded summary. get_app_state carries the revision too.

minor.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
minor.comment: Agents' calls go to the running copy of Parity that has their project open; --tab active names what the person is looking at, and a call without --tab goes to the project its folder is in

none.author: noreply@anthropic.com

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com

patch.author: ajcraswell@gmail.com
patch.comment: Every list of tokens, in the Tokens panel and the inspector's pickers, shares one order, smallest first.
